_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Strict Baseline 1 acceptance gates (openamrobot_build1_scene/baseline1_gates.py), Alex 20 Nov 2026. Proposed values; a change is a reviewed change of this file. Simulation evidence only.

liveness._comment: Work counters written to every trace sample by baseline1.Trace. Each must advance through the whole mission.

cancellation.note: the cancellation step of baseline1_cancel.py (Proposed, 20 Nov 2026) runs only with BASELINE1_CANCEL_CHECK=1; without it no cancel_* check runs

windows._comment: Named Gazebo-time windows from the mission's time marks (scenarios._mark): [start label, end label]. grasp_reach_last_move: from the start of scn04's last reach move (the straight move onto the end point, openamr-upperbody-sw #98) through the 1 s settle that ends grasp_reach.

allowed.reason: intended grasp: the fingers close on the item and hold it

residual end-point contact of the hand with the tote front wall, a simulation-model artifact of the base pitch (0.534 deg nose down, 2 mm up in Gazebo against a level planning scene); this exact case only (Mohamed, openamr-upperbody-sw #98, 20 Nov 2026)
the item stands in the tote (environment only, no robot link)
the tote stands on shelf level 0 (environment only, no robot link)
the payload box stands on shelf level 1 (environment only, no robot link; PROPOSED, awaiting Alex)
